recommendedTextbook.title: Comprehensive Economics for Senior Secondary Schools
recommendedTextbook.author: J. U. Anyaele
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

subtopics: Definitions of Economics (Adam Smith, Alfred Marshall, Lionel Robbins)
Basic concepts: Wants, scarcity, choice, scale of preference, opportunity cost
objectives: Analyze Lionel Robbins's definition of Economics
Construct an individual scale of preference
Calculate opportunity cost in decision scenarios

subtopics: Tables, charts (pie chart, bar chart, histogram)
Measures of central tendency: Mean, median, mode
Economic graphs and calculating slopes of linear curves
objectives: Compute mean, median and mode from grouped and ungrouped data
Construct pie charts representing national trade data
Interpret slopes of economic demand and supply curves

topics.topic: Theory of Production and Factors of Production
subtopics: Meaning and types of production (primary, secondary, tertiary)
Factors of production: Land, labour, capital, entrepreneurship
Rewards of factors of production: Rent, wages, interest, profit
objectives: Distinguish between direct and indirect production
Analyze characteristics and rewards of each factor of production
Examine mobility of labour in Nigeria

subtopics: Meaning and origins of division of labour
Advantages and disadvantages of division of labour
Limitations of division of labour: Extent of the market and capital
objectives: Evaluate psychological effects of repetitive assembly work
Assess how market size limits specialization in West Africa
